Atlantis NDT Partner Program 2028 — Channel + Reseller + Implementation Tracks

Atlantis NDT Partner Program brings inspection contractors, EPC consultants, training providers, and systems integrators into a structured global partner ecosystem. Designed to extend Atlantis NDT delivery reach without diluting Atlantis NDT Level III-led quality. Four partner tracks, each with distinct onboarding + revenue model + co-marketing commitment.

Track 1 — Referral Partner

For inspection contractors, EPC consultants, and asset-owner technical leads who refer enterprise customers to Atlantis NDT. Earn ongoing referral commission per closed customer (term + scope qualitative — affordable model, fully customizable). No technical certification required. Minimal commitment — refer + introduce, Atlantis NDT delivery team owns the consultation + scoping + close. Suited for individuals + small consultancies with executive relationships at refining + petrochem + marine + aerospace + LNG operators.

Track 2 — Reseller Partner

For systems integrators + technology resellers + ERP consultancies that want to sell Atlantis NDT ERP + Digital Twin platform + Reporting Software + Atlantis LMS under their own brand or co-branded. Includes sales enablement (battle cards, demo scripts, ROI calculators per vertical), pre-sales technical support, co-selling on enterprise opportunities, dedicated channel-account-manager. Reseller partners go through 4-week onboarding + product certification + signed channel agreement.

Track 3 — Implementation Partner

For consulting firms (Big-4 + boutique inspection-engineering specialists) that deliver Atlantis NDT software implementation projects to enterprise customers. Implementation partners go through 6-week technical certification — covers data migration, integration scoping (SAP, Oracle, Maximo, NetSuite, ServiceNow), inspector roster onboarding, code-stack mapping, Level III-led acceptance testing. Atlantis NDT delivery team backstops every implementation partner project — partners never deliver alone on first 3 enterprise projects.

Track 4 — Training Partner

For accredited training providers (NDT training schools, in-house corporate training functions, EPC training divisions) that want to deliver Atlantis NDT Academy curriculum to their cohorts under licence. LMS-powered, ASNT NDT Level III-co-led, 96% first-pass cohorts, free retake-grade backstop. Training partners go through 4-week trainer certification + signed academic partnership agreement + annual cohort quality audit.

Onboarding Timeline + Co-Marketing Commitment

Onboarding: Track 1 — 2 weeks (sign + brief + go); Track 2 — 4 weeks; Track 3 — 6 weeks (technical cert + acceptance testing); Track 4 — 4 weeks (trainer cert + quality audit setup). All tracks include co-marketing — joint webinars, joint conference presence, joint LinkedIn + YouTube + PR. Atlantis NDT contributes case-study templates + thought-leadership content + sales-deck templates. Partners contribute regional relationships + local-market intelligence + co-funded events.

Free Consultation + Partnership Scoping

Every prospective partner gets a free 30-minute scoping consultation with Atlantis NDT founder + channel-account-manager. Output: recommended track, onboarding timeline, commercial model, co-marketing commitments, mutual references. Tailored partnership agreement within 1-2 weeks of consultation. Affordable, accessible, fully customizable. Book your free partner scoping consultation.
